events.text: Prince George of Teck was educated at Eton College.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Prince George of Teck was educated at Eton College

events.text: He then studied at Magdalen College, Oxford.
events.subject: self

events.text: He joined the Reserve Regiment of the 1st Life Guards during World War I.
events.subject: self
events.object: Reserve Regiment of the 1st Life Guards
events.quote: He joined the Reserve Regiment of the 1st Life Guards during World War I

events.text: He served as an aide-de-camp on the Personal Staff in 1918.
events.subject: self
events.quote: served as an aide-de-camp on the Personal Staff in 1918–1919

events.text: His service as an aide-de-camp on the Personal Staff ended in 1919.
events.subject: self
events.quote: served as an aide-de-camp on the Personal Staff in 1918–1919

events.text: He served with the Territorial Army as a lieutenant in the Shropshire Yeomanry from 1921.
events.subject: self
events.quote: as a lieutenant in the Shropshire Yeomanry from 1921

events.text: He served as captain in the 16th Battalion, London Regiment from 1929.
events.subject: self
events.quote: then as captain in the 16th Battalion , London Regiment from 1929 to 1932

events.text: His service as captain in the 16th Battalion, London Regiment ended in 1932.
